verdicts.reasoning: Compose is exhibited consistently across samples. All items show combining groups into totals: seed 11 combines 5+0, seed 23 combines implicitly in the left-over operation, seed 42 combines 5+0, seed 78 combines 4+1, seed 1019462434 combines 3+2. The competency explicitly names compose and the samples show this operation frequently throughout.

Decompose is exhibited consistently across samples. Samples show splitting numbers into two groups: seed 42 decomposes 5 into 5 and 0, seed 57 shows decomposing into groups, seed 91 decomposes 5 into 2 and 3, seed 103 decomposes 5 into 0 and 5. The operation of splitting a total into two groups is demonstrated throughout the packet.

The clause 'numbers' is provided throughout. All samples work explicitly with specific numbers: seed 11 with 5, seed 23 with 10, seed 42 with 5, seed 57 with 5, seed 64 with 5, seed 78 with 4 and 1, seed 91 with 5. Numbers are the core mathematical entities being composed and decomposed across all items.

The clause 'up to 10' is provided. Most samples use numbers at or below 5. Seed 23 explicitly uses 10 blocks. Seeds 3688724978 and 3689674714 combine 7 and 3 blocks to reach 10. The range extends throughout the 0-10 domain required by the competency.

Concrete materials are shown throughout via emoji representations of physical objects. Seed 42 shows shells 🐚🐚🐚🐚🐚, seed 78 shows stones 🪨🪨🪨🪨 🪨, seed 91 specifies buttons, seed 103 uses shells, seed 127 shows counters 🔴🔴🔴🔴🔴, seed 918368289 uses buttons 🔘🔘🔘🔘🔘, seed 919053599 shows counters. The materials (counters, blocks, beads, buttons, shells, sticks) appear consistently.
